##### Project general facts

Velor is a statement of refined urban living, positioned among globally recognized landmarks and designed to offer a lifestyle defined by elegance, exclusivity, and attention to detail. The development presents a seamless fusion of architecture and experience, where every element — from spatial design to everyday interactions — is carefully curated to create a sense of sophistication and ease.

The building’s exterior stands out with its sleek lines, bold contours, and expansive glazing, creating a striking architectural identity that balances openness with grandeur. Floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light while framing panoramic views, enhancing the sense of space throughout. Inside, residences are designed with generous layouts and open-plan living areas that emphasize comfort and fluidity, complemented by premium finishes that elevate the overall living experience.

Velor offers a comprehensive range of amenities and services tailored to modern lifestyles, supporting wellness, relaxation, and recreation. The interiors continue this refined approach with high-quality materials and thoughtful detailing, while kitchens are equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, custom cabinetry, and premium stone countertops. Spa-inspired bathrooms further enhance the sense of tranquility, resulting in a residential environment that combines contemporary design with everyday comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities. 

The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. 

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
